description: Critical/high OSV advisories in the shipped OpenCode CLI closure that cannot be fixed without an upstream dependency bump. Every entry needs a reason and an expiry; the gate fails when an expiry passes while the advisory is still reachable.

scope.rationale: Production dependency closure of the CLI that the native Termux build bundles. Dev-only workspaces and tooling are out of scope.

entries.reason: Pinned transitively by gitlab-ai-provider. Fixed in zod 4.6.6, which is outside the provider's supported range; requires an upstream bump.

No fixed picomatch release exists yet (the advisory lists last_affected 4.0.7). Pulled transitively by micromatch@4.0.8. The ReDoS requires a crafted single-branch repeated extglob pattern; project-controlled instruction globs are bounded by the config guard, and the remaining uses are file/build tooling rather than a network service. Re-evaluate when upstream ships a fixed release.
